author: DeltaHawk2014
body: I was banned today for making a joke, but I guess it was taken seriously, like all my jokes.... IF unbanned, I could show my gratitude for the server by continuing to make YT videos, or design maps. I play on survival servers a lot, so I'm good at building. If all goes well, I may donate.
